SELECT strftime(sale_date,'%Y-%m') m, channel_code, channel_id, staff_purchase_flag, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dist_lines, sum(gross_amount) gross, sum(net_amount) net, min(sale_date), max(sale_date), min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at)
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-25' AND DATE '2024-10-05' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

SELECT strftime(f.sale_date,'%Y-%m') m, f.channel_code, s.store_id, s.store_name, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dl, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) drl, sum(f.gross_amount) gross, sum(round(f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate),2)) recomputed, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx, sum(CASE WHEN f.quantity<=0 OR f.gross_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos
FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT 'closure' k, store_id::VARCHAR a, closure_type b, closure_start_date::VARCHAR c, closure_end_date::VARCHAR d, weeks_closed::VARCHAR e FROM ref_store_closure WHERE closure_start_date <= DATE '2024-10-01' AND closure_end_date >= DATE '2024-07-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'tsdate', strftime(f.sale_date,'%Y-%m'), CASE WHEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', timezone('UTC', f.sale_ts_utc)) AS DATE)=f.sale_date THEN 'match_local' WHEN CAST(f.sale_ts_utc AS DATE)=f.sale_date THEN 'match_utc_only' ELSE 'neither' END, count(*)::VARCHAR, sum(f.gross_amount)::VARCHAR, NULL
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.channel_code='ST' AND s.store_id<900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 2,3
UNION ALL
SELECT 'nontrading', d.day_name, d.holiday_name, count(*)::VARCHAR, sum(f.gross_amount)::VARCHAR, strftime(min(f.sale_date),'%Y-%m-%d')
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE f.channel_code='ST' AND s.store_id<900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND NOT d.is_trading_day GROUP BY 2,3

WITH f AS (SELECT strftime(f.sale_date,'%Y-%m') m, s.store_id, f.staff_purchase_flag sp, f.net_amount, f.gross_amount FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.channel_code='ST' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'),
r AS (SELECT strftime(business_date,'%Y-%m') m, sum(net_sales_before_returns) rpt_net, sum(CASE WHEN store_id<900 THEN net_sales_before_returns END) rpt_net_lt900, sum(CASE WHEN store_id=999 THEN net_sales_before_returns END) rpt999, count(*) n FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1),
d AS (SELECT strftime(f.sale_date,'%Y-%m') m, count(*) dup_groups FROM (SELECT sale_date, receipt_id, product_key, sale_ts_utc, quantity, net_amount, count(*) c FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY ALL HAVING count(*)>1) f GROUP BY 1)
SELECT f.m, sum(net_amount) fact_net_all_st, sum(CASE WHEN store_id<900 THEN net_amount END) fact_net_store, sum(CASE WHEN store_id<900 AND NOT sp THEN net_amount END) fact_net_nostaff, any_value(r.rpt_net) rpt_net, any_value(r.rpt_net_lt900) rpt_lt900, any_value(r.rpt999) rpt999, any_value(d.dup_groups) dups
FROM f JOIN r USING (m) LEFT JOIN d USING (m) GROUP BY f.m ORDER BY 1

SELECT f.sale_date, d.day_name, d.is_trading_day, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) stores, count(*) n, sum(f.gross_amount) gross
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE f.channel_code='ST' AND s.store_id<900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY ALL HAVING count(DISTINCT s.store_id) < 36 OR NOT d.is_trading_day ORDER BY 1

SELECT strftime(f.sale_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(f.gross_amount) AS store_sales_incl_vat_before_returns
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
WHERE f.channel_code = 'ST' AND s.store_id < 900
  AND f.sale_date >= DATE '2024-08-01' AND f.sale_date < DATE '2024-10-01'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
